name: Underwriter can add and calculate EPD at every offer stage
description:
Objective: Underwriter can add and calculate EPD at every offer stage.
Preconditions: Open Early payment discount with the configured test data.
Steps:
1. Open Early payment discount.
2. Underwriter can add and calculate EPD at every offer stage.
3. Observe the resulting state.
Expected: The requested change is saved and the resulting state is visible to the user.
